verdict.rationale: Asana's own app components let developers plug custom UI directly into the Asana interface, but the documented surfaces are limited to tasks and rules. Nothing in the evidence shows custom views or dashboard widgets. missing for 10: custom view surfaces, dashboard widget surfaces, detail on native look-and-feel/design components, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a designer, I can build custom views and dashboard widgets that feel native to the product

citations.quote: Plug your app directly into the Asana UI with app components. Build app components on the surface of tasks or rules so that customers can use their favorite tools and stay in flow.
